_comment: Acceptance thresholds for the agent evaluation harness (ADR-0032). These are regression floors set at the deterministic backend's measured baseline on a small KB-derived gold set; they are NOT clinical acceptance criteria. 5-class exact accuracy is reported but deliberately not gated: the automated evidence available (ClinVar + gnomAD only) cannot reach full Pathogenic under ACMG combining rules, so the known conservative P->LP bias would make a 5-class gate meaningless.

gates.name: citation_integrity
gates.description: No fabricated ClinVar citations; evidence codes traceable to tool output (all tiers, including no-ClinVar probes)
